text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The three years I raced through alongside Mejiro Ramonu—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Beside a girl who simply loved racing,
I pursued racing with single-minded devotion...
Looking back, that's truly what those days felt like.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And now—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Pardon me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
“I am Daiichi Ruby.
I contacted you the other day.”
choice_data_list: Yeah, I've been waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much for taking the time to meet with me.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "Getting straight to the point, have you had a chance to look over the materials I sent the other day?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
My goal is to eventually achieve
great things along the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Just like Lady Ramonu.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: As I continue my training, I have some questions regarding my running style at medium distances.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
And so, hoping to receive your valuable insight,
I requested your time today.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'll leave it in your capable hands.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —I see...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
That was very helpful.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—Lately, girls aiming for
the Tiara path have been coming to me
frequently with questions."
choice_data_list: (I wonder if this is fate at work too...?)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Nnh... Maybe I should just give up...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Still, it might turn out just fine...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Is that small figure Nishino Flower, perhaps?
She skipped a grade thanks to her outstanding grades and entered Tracen Academy."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... I-I'm fine!
It's nothing at a—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Urgh...
choice_data_list: ...Would you mind if I took a quick look at you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she just pushed herself too hard and felt a little unwell.
After letting her rest in the shade—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, and thank you so much...
I'm all right now.
choice_data_list: Why don't you rest a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if I don't give it my all...
I'll never catch up to everyone!”

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm a little smaller
than the other girls my age...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, Trainer...
You're Mejiro Ramonu-san's
Trainer, right?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...What should I do
to grow big and strong like Ramonu-san?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
choice_data_list: Eat plenty and get good sleep!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"Try your best"...
Wait, not that?
choice_data_list: Ramonu eats well and sleeps well, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so?
Oohh~~...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, Ramonu-san is...!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"...I think I'll rest for today!
Thank you so much for helping me!"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm gonna get super big!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Later today, I was scheduled to attend a race study session at Tokyo Racecourse together with the URA staff.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Right now... for the sake of the future of the races I love,
I'm gradually being entrusted with all kinds of duties."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's a lot to learn and do, which makes it tough, but every day feels truly rewarding.
And, of course... that's not all.

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
――Ah, there they are!
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
No, you're right on time for the meetup.
More importantly...

text_block_list.name: URA Staff Member
text_block_list.text:
I saw her sitting in the stands;
is she today's special guest?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Shh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: It's starting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: “—Our beloved races are...”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Racing Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaahhhhhh!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —How lovely.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
There is no way I could ever leave you.
Not from you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"From love that fills my heart...
so completely."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll pick out our next race.
Yeah, I'll pick out our next race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I look forward to our time together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A fluttering feeling.
Like falling in love for the first time...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Thrilling, heart-pounding.
As if everything is being swept away—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Dedicate a race...
to me, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What a lovely expression.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Come...
Let us arrive at the next love.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And of course, I will be
right there by Mejiro Ramonu's side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until that love runs dry... which is to say, such a day will probably never come—
and yet, it will arrive before we know it.
